title: Schedule
note: A Schedule starts a new Task on the Machine at the time you set, in your name, even with your phone off. If there is nothing to tell you, the Task stays out of your Inbox.
offline: The Machine is offline, so Schedules can't be changed right now.

missing.title: Agent not found
missing.body: This Agent is no longer on this device.

empty.title: No Schedules yet
empty.body: Add one to have the Agent start work on its own, every few minutes, every day or every week.

editor.footer: Times are on the Machine's own clock. A round is skipped while the Agent is busy or its Budget is used up.
editor.textPlaceholder: Check the CI and tell me what failed

state.suspended: Stopped for good: the key that set it was revoked

empty.title: Nothing to do
empty.body: Write what the Agent should do each round.

tooOften.title: Too often
tooOften.body: A Schedule runs at most every 15 minutes, and at least once a week.

badTime.title: Not a time
badTime.body: Write the time as HH:MM, from 00:00 to 23:59.

delete.title: Delete this Schedule?
delete.message: {{name}} stops running it. Tasks it already started stay.
